column2: and all its good things have not, as into a vessel full of holes,
if you should go on living to outlast all generations,
would she not rightly cry out louder and rebuke in a sharp voice:
but since you always crave what is absent and scorn what is here,
and death, unlooked for, has taken its stand at your head
this, I think, is what they mean by the girls in the flower of age {{NOTE: the Danaids, punished in the underworld by carrying water in leaking vessels}}
robbed of the light, poured out his spirit from a dying body.

column1: # 3.1040 memores motus = the remembering motions (memory failing), not "mindful".

column2: warned him that the remembering motions of his mind were slackening,
